overview.description: The Corgi Travel & Leisure ETF (WNDR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund seeks capital appreciation through a portfolio of companies tied to theglobal travel and leisure value chain, from airlines and cruise lines to booking platforms, loyalty programs, lodging operators, and ground transportation networks. WNDR was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.

holdings.infoBox: WNDR is an equity ETF with a total of 58 individual holdings. The top holdings are The Walt Disney Company stock at 6.65%, American Express Company at 5.75%, First American Government Obligs X at 5.73%, Uber Technologies at 4.48%, and Booking Holdings at 4.23%.
